panels.description: Displays the number of newly generated alerts that have not yet been reviewed or assigned to an analyst. This metric represents the current backlog of alerts awaiting triage.
panels.title: Open Alerts

panels.description: Shows the number of alerts currently under investigation by SOC analysts. These alerts are actively being analyzed to determine whether they represent a true security incident.
panels.title: Alerts Under Investigation

panels.description: Represents the number of alerts that have been fully investigated and resolved. Closed alerts include confirmed incidents that have been mitigated as well as benign events that required no further action.
panels.title: Closed Alerts

panels.description: Shows the number of alerts that have been escalated to higher-tier analysts or incident response teams due to increased severity, complexity, or confirmed malicious activity.
panels.title: Escalated Alerts

panels.description: Displays alerts that were investigated and determined to be benign or non-malicious activity. Tracking false positives helps measure detection accuracy and identify opportunities to improve detection rules.
panels.title: False Positives

panels.description:
Displays the number of high-impact security alerts classified as Critical severity. These alerts indicate potential serious threats such as ransomware activity, credential compromise, or system exploitation that require immediate attention.

⚠️ Requires immediate investigation.
panels.title: Critical Alerts

panels.description: Displays alert activity over time grouped by investigation status. This timeline helps detect spikes in alert generation and track how alert volumes change during security events or attacks.
panels.title: Alert Status Timeline

panels.description: Shows the distribution of alerts based on severity levels. This panel helps identify the proportion of high-risk alerts compared to lower priority events.
panels.title: Alerts By Severity

panels.description: Visualizes the distribution of alerts across different investigation statuses. This helps analysts and SOC managers quickly understand the current alert handling progress.
panels.title: Alerts By Status

panels.description: Shows the real-time queue of all SOC alerts with key metadata including alert ID, severity, source, host, user, timestamp, analyst assignment, and current status. This panel serves as the primary workspace for analysts to monitor and triage incoming security alerts.
panels.title: SOC Alerts Queue

panels.description: Shows which endpoints generate the most alerts.
panels.title: Alerts by Host

panels.description: Shows users responsible for generating the highest number of alerts in the environment.
panels.title: Alerts By Users

panels.description: Shows which source generates the most alerts.
panels.title: Alerts by Source

panels.description:
Displays the age of the oldest open alert in the SOC queue. 
This metric helps analysts identify alerts that have been unresolved for the longest time and may indicate investigation backlog or SLA violations.
panels.title: Oldest Open Alert

panels.description: Average time between alert creation and closure. Indicates SOC response efficiency.
panels.title: Mean Time To Respond (MTTR)

panels.description: Displays the number of alerts that exceeded the defined investigation SLA based on severity levels. Helps identify delayed responses and potential operational bottlenecks.
panels.title: Alerts Breaching SLA

panels.description: Shows the number of alerts generated per minute. Sudden spikes may indicate active attacks, scanning activity, or alert floods requiring investigation.
panels.title: Alert Rate (Alerts / Minute)

panels.description: Total number of security alerts generated by detection systems (SIEM, EDR, and host telemetry) during the current day. This metric provides visibility into the daily alert volume processed by the Security Operations Center.
panels.title: Total Alerts Detected Today

panels.description: Number of alerts successfully investigated and closed by SOC analysts today. This metric reflects daily incident response activity and analyst productivity within the Security Operations Center.
panels.title: Alerts Resolved Today

panels.description: Alerts investigated and classified as benign or non-malicious by SOC analysts today. Monitoring this metric helps evaluate detection accuracy and identify opportunities to improve alert tuning.
panels.title: False Positive Alerts Today

panels.description: Alerts escalated by Tier 1 analysts to higher investigation tiers or incident response teams today. This metric highlights alerts requiring deeper analysis due to complexity or potential threat severity.
panels.title: Alerts Escalated Today

panels.description: Current threat level based on active high and critical alerts.
panels.title: SOC Threat Level

panels.description: Average time between alert creation and the start of investigation. Indicates how quickly analysts begin triaging new alerts.
panels.title: Mean Time To Investigate (MTTI)

panels.description: Average time analysts spend investigating alerts before escalating them to a higher tier. This metric reflects investigation efficiency and helps identify alerts that require deeper expertise.
panels.title: Escalation Delay

panels.description: Average time analysts spend investigating alerts before they are resolved.
panels.title: Investigation Duration

panels.description: Shows how alerts are distributed among SOC analysts.
panels.title: Alerts Assigned to Analysts

panels.description: Shows analyst activity metrics including investigated, escalated, closed, and false positive alerts. Helps track analyst workload, response actions, and overall SOC operational performance.
panels.title: Analyst Performance

panels.description: Displays real-time SOC investigation activity and analyst actions.
panels.title: Live SOC Activity Feed

panels.description: Distribution of alerts by MITRE ATT&CK tactic
panels.title: Threat Category (MITRE ATT&CK)

panels.description: Displays detection rules generating the highest number of alerts. Helps identify noisy detections, attack trends, and opportunities for rule tuning.
panels.title: Top Alerting Rules

list.label: Status
list.name: status
list.query: Open : open, Closed : closed, Investigating : investigating, False Positive : false_positive, Escalated : escalated
